room_rent.note: Policy wording does not impose any room rent sub-limit; room and boarding covered as part of in-patient treatment without a stated cap.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under in-patient treatment with no stated sub-limit.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment. Co-payment of 10% or 20% is an optional benefit; once opted it cannot be removed.

sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation; emergency air ambulance capped at ₹2.5L per hospitalisation. Daily cash for shared accommodation is a fixed benefit (₹800/day up to ₹4,800 for 3L-15L; ₹1,000/day up to ₹6,000 for 20L+). No disease-wise sub-limits on main indemnity cover.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional aggregate deductible of ₹25K/₹50K/₹1L can be opted at inception; applies on floater basis.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, cholecystectomy, sinusitis, GERD, calculus diseases, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is excluded from base plan (Excl18). Available via 'Parenthood' add-on covering maternity, embryo storage and IVF with 2-year waiting period.

cumulative_bonus.note: Multiplier Benefit: 50% of Base SI added each renewal irrespective of claims, capped at 100% of Base SI. Available on floater basis for all insured persons.

restoration.note: Restore Benefit: 100% of Base SI restored once per policy year on complete or partial utilisation; available on floater basis. Unlimited Restore (optional) allows unlimited restorations.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. Emergency air ambulance up to ₹2.5L per hospitalisation (within India only).

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly list modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit; covered under general in-patient treatment if medically necessary.

consumables.note: Base plan excludes items in List I (consumables/non-medical). 'Protector Rider' add-on covers IRDAI-listed excluded items.

global_cover.note: Base plan covers India only. 'Critical Advantage rider' covers planned treatment abroad for 8 major illnesses.

notable_exclusions: Maternity (base), treatment outside India, sleep apnoea, external congenital anomalies, consumables (List I), alcoholic cirrhosis (permanent), OPD treatment
optional_riders: Unlimited Restore, Parenthood (maternity+IVF), Protector Rider (consumables), Critical Advantage (overseas), ABCD Chronic Care, Optima Wellbeing (OPD), Personal Accident Rider, Hospital Daily Cash, my:health Critical Illness
